en: Ah, young Miss.  You look bored.
I'm not bored.
If you've got time, could you help me out a little with the chores?
As I said I'm not bored!
A lot of housework has piled up so I'm a bit overwhelmed.
Hey!  Pay attention when someone's talking to you!
Fuffuffu.  You'd really be helping me out, young Miss.
As-I-said, listen to what I'm saying!!
*huff puff*
Huhun.  Thank you very much.  That was a big help.
*pant pant* T-that's all of it right?
Huhuhu, Not a chance I'm afraid.
Look, there's still plenty left.
Gack!
Come on, Miss.  Naturally, you're going to keep helping until we've finished it all aren't you?
You've got to be kidding!
Aw, that's too bad.
Putting off housework is nothing but a temporary reprieve, and it'll only make things harder later.  Keeekkekekeke.
Huh?
Lucille's not here?
Where could she have gotten to now?
Oh?  Could this be Lucille's diary?
Obviously, I have no choice but to look through it.
Uhuhuhu.  Well then I think I'll open it right up posthaste.
The world doesn't always go exactly as one hopes.
That girl is somehow interfering with my plans.  Truly an eyesore she is.
I must remove this obstacle, and preferably by my own hand...
There are any number of ways to accomplish it.
For instance, if I were to poison the food, that would take the obstacle right out.  That girl...
W-what is this?!  Poison the food?!
It can't be!  She was targeting me?
Lucille!  Lucille!!  Where'd you go?
Could she have run away?
Fine!  I'm definitely going to find you and drag the truth out of you if I have to!
Oh my, Miss? What do you want?
Don't tell me you've elected to abandon the professor after all.
Huhuhu! I knew it, protecting your own life is more important than saving his.
Oh, am I wrong?
If so, how about you get going on the double? Before it's too late?
Can't say I'd mind if you gave up on him though. Keeekkekekekeke.
Miss, what have you come here for?
Just visiting.
Since you've apparently got the time to dawdle about in my humble little room, how about you take your leave?
If you don't hurry up the professor's surely going to.... kekekeke.
D-don't say frightening things like that!
And speaking of, that laugh creeps me out so it'd be great if you could put the kibosh on it.
Goodness, how rude. What is the matter with you?
Ah, er, well. I'm sorry.
See here! Please stop idling about and make haste to go. The professor's waiting for you, no?
O-okay I will.
